name: Modular exterior building
description: 200 cm wall/floor grid with door and window openings; flat roof. Basic exterior, not a detailed furnished interior.
prompt_hint: Add a small modular building with width_tiles3 and depth_tiles3, placed clear of roads and other buildings.

name: Two-lane street
description: Two 3.5 metre lanes with 1.5 metre pavements. No traffic simulation.
prompt_hint: Add a connected straight two-lane road with pavements; north/south tiles use yaw0, east/west tiles use yaw90.

name: Crossroads
description: Four-way junction with crossings. Adjacent road directions are validated.
prompt_hint: Use a cross road tile at cell[0,0], yaw0. Extensions at [0,1] and [0,-1] use yaw0, at [1,0] and [-1,0] use yaw90. Keep buildings outside all road tiles.

name: Alpine mountain backdrop
description: Procedural distant range. Flat foreground; not a downloaded mountain mesh.
prompt_hint: Add a mountain backdrop behind the scene at +Y: enabled true, height_cm50000, size_cm180000, distance_cm140000, side_deg90.

name: Village starting layout
description: A prompt starting point, not a finished dressed set. Generated plans still need review.
prompt_hint: Build two modular houses at [-1800,-400] and [1000,-400], each width_tiles3 depth_tiles3, beside one straight road tile cell[0,0] yaw0. Add spruce trees well outside building and road footprints.
